title: Müggelseedamm, Berlin

title: Müggelseedamm, Berlin
description:
Artist & Musician Appartement with Piano near Müggelsee

Looking for a bright, inspiring place to live and create?  
Our top-floor, fully furnished artist apartment with a high-quality acoustic piano is available for a fixed-term rental of 6 months (possible to extend), starting April 1st (or March 30th). 

This apartment is intended as a temporary home for a musician or artist — a place to live, practice, and work in calm and light. It is ideal for a solo renter or a couple who values space, nature, and an atmosphere shaped by artistic life rather than short-term tourism.  

Apartment Features: 
Size: 55m2, two-room apartment 
Occupancy: 1 person or a couple (max. 2 people) 
Top Floor: Filled with natural light and open views, with beautiful sunrises and sunsets 
Piano: high-quality Schimmel acoustic piano, in excellent condition → Daytime practice is welcome and not a problem 
Flooring: Beautiful wooden oak floors throughout  

Kitchen & Living 
Fully equipped kitchen (dishwasher, oven, fridge/freezer, toaster, etc.) 
Hi-Fi system with Bluetooth receiver 
Carefully selected furniture, lamps, and artistic objects
A lived-in, respectful atmosphere — not a party rental  

Bathroom 
Bathtub 
Washing machine  

Location 
4–5 minutes walk to forest, Müggelsee lake, and nearby beach 
Many restaurants and cafés in the area 
Shopping nearby: Bio Company & Aldi (1 min), Edeka & Rossmann (6 min), Alnatura (12 min)  

Transport 
Approx. 40 minutes to Alexanderplatz  

Conditions 
Preferred term: around 6 months, flexible and extendable 
Rent: €1,234 per month (all-inclusive) 
Deposit: €1,500 
Anmeldung: possible
House rules: No smoking, no pets, no parties  

If this apartment speaks to you, and you can imagine yourself living, creating, or practicing here with care, please get in touch and tell us a little about yourself.
